author: /root/continuity_investigator
contract: Non-force init preserves existing CAIRNTIR_HOME and CAIRNTIR_GRANT_FILE on every JSON host scope, and unrelated configuration.
Restarting after init does not widen an existing read grant to owner access.
CAIRNTIR_HOME ordinary relative environment overrides raise ConfigError before any directory or database creation, including read-only resolution.
A tilde-prefixed CAIRNTIR_HOME expands to the platform home; literal tilde directories are not created.
An absolute CAIRNTIR_HOME retains verbatim acknowledged checkpoint identity across a fresh process launched from another working directory.
Explicit CLI setup --home relative paths are made absolute before host registration.

verification_reserve.test_edits_after_freeze: forbidden; supporting probes must be separately labeled

limitations: Executed on Windows; portable assertions are intended for CI on macOS and Linux, but no live macOS result is claimed.
Frozen subprocesses substitute HashEmbeddingProvider only; scoped access uses the real startup token, store, scope facade and backend, not live commercial host automation.
The explicit CLI setup path test intercepts host registration to prevent user configuration writes, model downloads and expensive inference; it proves normalization at that boundary only.
The earlier disposable report records real stdio MCP processes for acknowledgement, interruption, replay, CAS, ambiguity, terminal state and grant-loss consequences.
